definitions.gloss: reload; refresh; re-loading of data or a page
definitions.explanation: The act of loading content again, most commonly used for refreshing a web page or reloading data in a software application. The Japanese equivalent of 'reload' or 'refresh' in computing contexts.

examples.japanese: ページの{再読|さいよ}み{込|こ}みをしてください。
{画面|がめん}が{正|ただ}しく{表示|ひょうじ}されないときは、{再読|さいよ}み{込|こ}みを{試|ため}してみよう。
examples.english: When the screen doesn't display correctly, try doing a reload.

examples.japanese: ブラウザの{再読|さいよ}み{込|こ}みボタンを{押|お}すか、F5キーを{押|お}すと{最新|さいしん}の{情報|じょうほう}に{更新|こうしん}される。
examples.english: Pressing the browser's reload button or the F5 key will update the information to the latest version.

notes:
Composed of {再|さい} (again, re-) and {読|よ}み{込|こ}み (reading/loading in). A common computing term that appears in web browsers, applications, and technical documentation. The verb form is {再読|さいよ}み{込|こ}みする.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {再読|さいよ}み{込|こ}みする: to reload, to refresh
- {再読|さいよ}み{込|こ}みボタン: reload/refresh button
- {自動|じどう}{再読|さいよ}み{込|こ}み: auto-refresh
- {強制|きょうせい}{再読|さいよ}み{込|こ}み: hard reload/force refresh

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {更新|こうしん}: update — a broader term covering any kind of update, not limited to reloading
- リロード: reload — the English loanword, used more casually in tech contexts
- リフレッシュ: refresh — the English loanword for refresh
